audit.why: 48.43% over 733 games, matching the EVEN/6-10 framing already on the page.

edits.before: Level 1 favours Galio — his Winds of War poke and magic shield out-trade you.
edits.after: Level 1 is skill — his Winds of War poke trades with your Transfusion drain.

edits.before: Level 4 is even as your scaling starts catching his front-loaded kit.
edits.after: Level 4 stays his: Justice Punch is up every 8s and out-tempos your drain.

edits.before: Level 4 is even and level 5+ tips to you. His Justice Punch (E) into Hero's Entrance (R) taunt is real, but you can pool the engage, and on this island lane his ult is mostly a roam tool — ping and match it. Your scaling begins to outweigh his front-loaded poke around here.
edits.after: Level 4 still leans Galio and level 5+ tips to you. Justice Punch (E) is up every 8s at rank 3, but Sanguine Pool makes you untargetable for 2s — pool the punch and his knockup and the W taunt both whiff. On this island lane his R is mostly a roam tool: ping it and match tempo.

edits.before: Galio's Winds of War (Q) is heavy sustained magic poke that also heals him, and his magic-shield passive plus Shield of Durand (W) make him tanky against your Tides (E) and Transfusion (Q). Early he out-pokes and out-sustains you — dodge his Q's second tick and don't shove into his zone.
edits.after: Galio's Winds of War (Q) is heavy sustained magic poke, and his magic-shield passive plus Shield of Durand (W) blunt your damage. Tides of Blood (E) is blocked by enemy units, so it does nothing fired through the wave — last-hit from behind minions, dodge the Q's second tick, don't shove.

edits.before: Galio wastes Justice Punch — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Pool it: 2s untargetable eats the knockup and the taunt, then commit.

edits.before: That is Galio's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Pool is 28s at rank 1; spend it on chip and his E-punch engage kills you free.

edits.before: Track Galio's Justice Punch: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. When it is down — Q-drain, pool his answer.
edits.after: Justice Punch (E) is his dash-knockup, 8s at rank 3. Pool it — 2s untargetable wastes the punch and the W taunt. Tides is unit-blocked.

notes: Packet defect 'His Justice Punch' is a FALSE POSITIVE — Justice Punch is Galio's real E name. Chart rows left untouched; they already agree across win[] and phases[].side and with the mirror. Unwritten but true: Justice Punch can cut your retreat and Vladimir has no dash, and Colossal Smash (P) is the auto-reset wind-up tell before his combo.
